The database login is per service (DP-02). Its name is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1023; ASM-1928); the story refers to "the rwb-document login (DP-02)".

edits.new:
- The parameters and reference lists arrive through DP-06 and DP-07; the migration is one step in the per-service Flyway sequence (DP-15); the event is in the outbox (DP-09); the engine evaluates no rule package and loads no Drools kit.
- The generation operation is `POST /cases/{caseId}/generated-documents` on the base `/api/recovery/document/v1` (Ownership Map and TSD P5 API-P5-016); the architecture slide 16 name `POST /documents/generate` is not used (ASM-101). The template version and merge field list are read only through the P6 catalog contract RWB-P6-E1046-CON (ASM-102); the document row adds `template_code` varchar(30) and `template_version` integer beside `template_id` and `treatment_id` (ASM-103).
